sections.title: Formation and Core Meaning: That Which Must / Will Be Done
sections.content: The suffix *-andó / -endő* attaches to verb stems to express obligation or future action: *megoldandó feladat* (a task to be solved / that must be solved), *követendő példa* (an example to be followed), *fejlesztendő terület* (an area to be developed).

items.spanish: A digitális átállás során sok a megoldandó probléma.
items.english: During the digital transition, there are many problems to be solved.

items.spanish: A biztonságos jelszó használata mindenki számára követendő szabály.
items.english: Using a secure password is a rule to be followed by everyone.
